author: CNN
description:
From ‘exploding trees’ to ‘Usha Vance’ to ‘Cities Church’, CNN reporters break down this week’s most-searched news topics, in ranked order.

See which story came out on top this week.

0:00 #10: Exploding trees
0:49 #9: Trump letter to Norway
1:56 #8: Cities Church
3:14 #7: Jack Smith
4:42 #6: Stock market
6:01 #5: Usha Vance
6:53 #4: Beckham family
7:55 #3: Brahim Díaz
8:54 #2: Oscar nominations
9:50 #1: Can you guess?

Note: Search volumes are based on data at the time of each Looped In episode's publication.

#Trending #Storm #News
title: Can you guess the most searched news story this week? | Looped In

author: CNN
description: DEK: CNN's Jacqueline Howard lists some easy ways to stay warm and safe if your power goes out during the winter storm.
title: Simple steps to stay warm if your power knocks out

author: CNN
description: USA Team Handball held trials for their Olympic team in California and will host more tryouts across the country. Three women who had never played the sport before decided to show up, but CEO of USA Team Handball Michael King says this more common than one would think.
title: One sport that may get you into the Olympics

author: CNN
description: CNN's Omar Jimenez reports from Minneapolis, where church volunteers have gathered to deliver meals to thousands ahead of the winter storm Fern. The pastor of the church says church attendance numbers are down by hundreds, likely because of the federal immigration enforcement in the neighborhood.
title: Church providing food to people afraid to leave home due to ICE enforcement

author: CNN
description:
Two-thirds of the US population is facing down a monster winter storm and extreme cold. The storm’s snow and ice will stretch over 2,000 miles from Texas to New England as it tracks east through the weekend. Thousands of flights have already been canceled ahead of the storm. Travel will be difficult to impossible on roads across the storm’s footprint.

For more, visit CNN's live updates page on the storm: https://cnn.it/3LHehCJ

0:00 CNN aviation reporter reports from Reagan National Airport
1:37 Half the country faces crippling winter storm
2:37 CNN meteorologist reports
6:14 FEMA halts layoffs, activates response teams

#WinterStorm #Storm #News
title: 1,800+ flights canceled as historic winter storm heads for US

author: CNN
description: Ryan Wedding, former Canadian Olympic snowboarder and the largest cocaine distributor in Canada, according to officials, has been arrested and is being placed in US custody. Wedding was taken to the US, arriving at the Ontario International Airport in Southern California where officials, including FBI Director Kash Patel, gave a press conference following his arrest. #CNN #News
title: Former Olympian and FBI Most Wanted fugitive Ryan Wedding arrested

author: CNN
description: Harrowing accounts of Iran’s bloodiest crackdown by the regime have been difficult to obtain and hard to reach amid a near-total internet blackout. CNN’s Jomana Karadsheh spoke with one protester who managed to leave the country, and whose experience matches what CNN and other organizations have managed to collect, pointing to a widespread, coordinated attack by the regime.
title: The night Iran went dark

author: CNN
description: A monster ice storm will soon stretch over 2000 miles of the United States. Hundreds of flights have already been canceled ahead of the storm.  CNN's Pete Muntean explains how to prepare. #cnn #flightcancellations #icestorm #travelpreps
title: What to do if you have travel scheduled during massive storm

author: CNN
description: For most of its history, fur was the ultimate status symbol. But in recent decades it's become controversial due to concerns around animal cruelty. Now, it’s making something of a comeback as climate-conscious consumers weigh up the merits of vintage fur over faux alternatives. CNN Senior Style reporter Rachel Tashjian explains what to consider if you're thinking of wearing fur. #cnn #cnnstyle #vintagefur #ethicalfashion #styletrends
title: Vintage, faux or real fur: ethical considerations

author: CNN
description:
A content creator in Virginia says she helped erase $80,000 in overdue school lunch debt and raised nearly $200,000 in the process. It all started with one phone call a few years ago.

#CNN #News
title: Content creator says she paid off $80K in school lunch debt

author: CNN
description: Chinese surveillance companies may have been used to crack down on the recent Iranian protests. CNN's international correspondent Isobel Yeung explains how China's AI and facial recognition tech might have saved the Iranian regime.
title: Has Chinese surveillance been used on Iranian protesters?

author: CNN
description: Florida was ceded to restore order. Alaska was mocked as “Seward’s Folly.” And the US Virgin Islands were bought with literal gold. These are some of the most surprising land deals in American history.
title: The wildest land deals in US history

author: CNN
description: Federal immigration authorities allowed a suspect in a $100m jewelry heist to self deport himself to South America— before he could face a trial, according to prosecutors. Jeson Nelon Presilla Flores was one of seven people charged with stealing millions worth of jewelry, diamonds, emeralds, gold, rubies and designer watches in 2022. He pleaded not guilty to these charges before being deported.
title: $100m jewelry heist suspect deported before trial

author: CNN
description: A host of guests from Hollywood and the fashion industry paid their respects at the funeral of the late Italian fashion designer Valentino Garavani in Rome. #cnn #news
title: Star-studded guests arrive to the funeral of Valentino

author: CNN
description: Speaking to CNN's Laura Coates, Pastor Sergio Amezcua said he believes that ICE's actions in Minnesota are worse than those of Mexican cartels. Amezcua is a family friend of a 5-year-old who was detained by ICE, and said that agents used the child to draw his pregnant mother out of the house so they could arrest her. #cnn #minnesota #ICE
title: Pastor says ICE actions are worse than cartels

author: CNN
description: Dozens of inmates were able to hug their daughters for the first time in years, one of many reunions organized by a nonprofit called God Behind Bars. The organization works to give incarcerated people the tools they will need to re-enter society.
title: Teen hugs incarcerated father for first time in 14 years

author: CNN
description: Aboard Air Force One, Donald Trump said the US has “an armada” moving toward Iran “just in case,” renewing warnings over protests and Tehran’s nuclear program. #CNN #News
title: Trump says US warships moving toward Iran

author: CNN
description: The Olympic torch relay passed through Venice in the lead-up to the 2026 Winter Games that will be hosted in Italy. #CNN #news
title: Olympic flame reaches Venice ahead of 2026 Winter Games

author: CNN
description: The joint venture acquiring TikTok’s US assets has been formally established and has announced its leadership team, according to the company. CNN’s Kristie Lu Stout explains what this means. #CNN #News #TikTok
title: TikTok secures its future in the US

author: CNN
description:
Doctors have long prescribed pills and procedures. But for some people, that isn’t enough. Sanjay sits down with Julia Hotz, author of The Connection Cure, to explore the rise of social prescribing —linking patients to things like volunteering, art, or nature—and how a simple question, “What matters to you?”, can change the way people heal. 


#News #Podcast #Sanjaygupta
title: What matters to you? A new way to heal | Chasing Life

author: CNN
description: CNN reconstructed the January 3 mission to capture Venezuelan President Nicolás Maduro using eyewitness videos, mapping helicopter flight paths and building a 3D model. The analysis reveals the operation’s success depended on a couple of critical minutes and quite how dangerous these moments were.
title: 'Organized chaos’: Watch CNN’s forensic reconstruction of the US raid to capture Maduro

author: CNN
description: A Cumberland County, Maine correctional officer recruit was detained by federal agents in Portland’s Bayside neighborhood, according to the sheriff. CNN has reached out to DHS for comment but has not yet received a response.
title: Federal agents detain corrections officer recruit

author: CNN
description: A new memo obtained by the Associated Press says ICE agents can enter people’s homes without a warrant signed by a judge, allowing agents to exercise sweeping new powers. It’s a move, CNN’s Josh Campbell reports, that can potentially ramp up already tense interactions between the public and immigration officers. #cnn #news
title: ICE agents can enter homes without judge’s warrant, memo says

author: CNN
description:
A 5-year-old who was taken by federal agents from the driveway of his metro Minneapolis home Tuesday after returning from preschool is being held with his father at an Immigration and Customs Enforcement facility in Texas, according to school district officials and a family attorney.    




#News #ICE #Minneapolis
title: 5-year-old boy taken by ICE is being held at Texas Facility

author: CNN
description: 57 swastikas were painted on a children’s playground in a predominantly Jewish neighborhood in Brooklyn, New York, the second of two incidents that the NYPD’s hate crimes task force were investigating. Two 15-year olds were arrested in connection with the incidents. #brooklyn #nyc #cnn
title: 57 swastikas found in Brooklyn playground

author: CNN
description: The attorney for 5-year-old Liam Conejo Ramos and his father, who were taken by federal agents earlier this week, said the two were “not eluding ICE in any way.” He also pushed back on Vice President JD Vance’s comment that ICE agents were arresting an “illegal alien.”
title: Lawyer for 5-year-old taken by ICE pushes back on Vance's comments

author: CNN
description: Former special counsel Jack Smith, who brought two now-defunct criminal cases against President Donald Trump, defended the integrity of his investigation during a combative hearing Thursday on Capitol Hill. Former police officers who defended the Capitol on January 6 were in the room to watch the hearing, as well as the former leader of the right-wing militia group known as the Oath Keepers.
title: ‘F**k yourself’: Ex-officer beaten in Jan 6. riot shouts to GOP lawmaker

author: CNN
description:
Author Yiyun Li lost both of her children to suicide. Vincent at 16. James at 19. She talks with Anderson about why she doesn't use the words "grief" or "process," instead describing her pain as "an abyss," and a "wound that won't heal."

For more of “All There Is with Anderson Cooper” visit https://cnn.com/allthereis
title: ‘The wound that won’t heal’: Author Yiyun Li talks with Anderson about losing her two children
